title: Gavin M NDE 13150
content: I had no eyes so I saw nothing. I could feel; so, I knew I existed. I had the thought that I died and lost my wife and little boy. But there was no sadness, only joy at the thought of no more material world and no more stress or worry. I was free. I was space without any feeling of restriction. If I would have been in a room, I would have been the whole room. I had a feeling there was something safe and familiar. Then I realized that I was with my grandmother. We could communicate, but without words. I just knew what she was thinking and she knew what I was thinking. We were both just space. She let me know that I shouldn't get comfortable because I wouldn't be staying long. I remember thinking that I wasn't going anywhere. I was free. Next thing I know, I jump forward to waking up from a coma. My first thought was of Nan. I needed be with Nan, she still exists. Now, I'm not scared of death because I fully know that there is somewhere after this world. Background Information: Gender: Male Date NDE Occurred: 25/11/2016 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Yes Illness Heart attack Clinical death (cessation of breathing or heart function) Heart stopped for 46 minutes while receiving CPR How do you consider the content of your experience? Entirely pleasant Did you feel separated from your body? No. I clearly left my body and existed outside it How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? Normal consciousness and alertness. Fully aware of my existence At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? It was over so quick Were your thoughts speeded up? No Did time seem to speed up or slow down? No Were your senses More vivid than usual? No Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. No vision, just blackness Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. No hearing, no ears Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere? No Did you pass into or through a tunnel? No Did you see any beings in your experience? No Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? Yes Grandmother Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? No Did you see an unearthly light? No Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? A clearly mystical or unearthly realm. I was all space with no restrictions. I wasn't contained What emotions did you feel during the experience? Free Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? Incredible joy Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? I felt no longer in conflict with nature Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? Everything about myself or others. I knew the human body was a vessel we used to interact with this world, nothing more Did scenes from your past come back to you? No. Aware that I had passed Did scenes from the future come to you? No Did you come to a border or point of no return? No God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Do not know Have your religious practices changed since your experience? No What is your religion now? Do not know Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was entirely not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience. I use to think that when you die, you're dead and unaware. Like before birth. Nothing. Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes I am consciousness Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin. I felt connected to everything Did you see deceased or religious spirits? No Did you encounter or become aware of any beings who previously lived on earth who are described by name in religions (for example: Jesus, Muhammad, Buddha, etc.)? No During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? No During your experience, did you gain information about universal connection or oneness? Yes I was somewhere and it wasn't this dimension During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? No Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? No During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? No During your experience, did you gain information about an afterlife? No Did you gain information about how to live our lives? No During your experience, did you gain information about life's difficulties, challenges and hardships? No During your experience, did you gain information about love? No What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? Large changes in my life. Application, be thankful for this moment, for this moment is life. Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? Yes I'm a different being, so life is now different After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? No How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I remember the experience as accurately as other life events that occurred around the time of the experience. When I woke up, I wrote it all down in a note book. So haven't had to recall it. I can read what I wrote down and that's why I remember it all. Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? No Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes First day Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? No What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real. Eye opening What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No Is there anything else that you would like to add about your experience? No Are there any other questions that we could ask to help you communicate your experience? All good de6qwnu_nde

stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: No tunnel or light; experiencer reported being 'space' in blackness, communicating without words with deceased grandmother, then an abrupt return to waking from coma.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Reported having no senses (no eyes/ears) and experiencing existence as unrestricted 'space' ("If I would have been in a room, I would have been the whole room."), with no sadness about leaving family and joy at being free of the material world.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "I was space without any feeling of restriction."; "We were both just space."; "She let me know that I shouldn't get comfortable because I wouldn't be staying long."; "I knew the human body was a vessel we used to interact with this world, nothing more."
